outcome.technical: scripts/prescan.mjs: PLATFORM_KINDS table maps the extracts (containers dockerfiles/services, pipelines pipelines/jobs/artifacts/passes/deployTargets, iac resources/modules/references/variables/outputs, data-platform models/sources/tests/lineage) to slice keys images, services, pipelines, jobs, artifacts, passes, deployTargets, resources, iacModules, iacReferences, iacVariables, iacOutputs, dbtModels, dbtSources, dbtTests, lineage; KEY_ORDER prints them after stores and before imports (slice and summary); rows keep every extract field plus file/line/lines, evidence kept only when it has several places; summary weights added, and passes, iacReferences, iacVariables, iacOutputs, dbtTests, lineage are count-only so the summary budget (4200) and note are unchanged; a repo without the stacks emits no new key. Area stacks are deliberately NOT extended (tests/prescan-core.test.mjs pc3 pins an area's stacks to ['python'] and the explorer brief line prints them); the top-level stacks already list the four via the plug-ins' detect. scripts/merge.mjs: makePlatformNodes makes nodes from the rows (compose service as service/store/queue node with build-context paths and its Dockerfile cited; unbuilt Dockerfile as service node; pipeline file as pipeline node in delivery, job/stage as job node; Terraform/Bicep resource as resource and module as module node in platform with the module directory as paths; dbt model as model and source table as source node in data), reusing an explorer node of the same id/title for its kind, same cited block or same paths; cap 150 per stack counted in derivation skipped; deriveLayer draws edges depends (depends_on, needs, IaC references: from depends on to), artifact (producer to consumer, both places cited) and lineage (upstream to model, cited at the call), verified, foundBy static, deterministic; derivation row gains platformNodes only when nonzero. schema/archmap-model.schema.json: edge.type enum gains depends, lineage, artifact (additive; node.kind was already an open string). relation-taxonomy.md and model-schema.md document the new types, node kinds (pipeline, resource, model, source) and the merge derivation. agents/archmap-explorer.md: the four reference names added to its existing list, nothing else. Tests: pw7 in prescan-wiring (four fixtures: stacks, extract, slice/summary key order, row citations, count-only rows, budget, three code repos unchanged), s3 updated and s15 added in schema.test (new types accepted, unknown refused, every committed map under docs/architecture, tests/fixtures and skills/architecture-map/evals validates: 3+ maps), m35 to m35d in merge.test (real prescan output of the four fixtures: nodes, edges, evidence, determinism in slice order, explorer node reused, no platform extract gains nothing). Ran node --test tests/prescan-wiring.test.mjs tests/schema.test.mjs tests/merge.test.mjs: all pass. Whole suite node --test: 565 tests, 564 pass, 1 fail: r2 in tests/skill-references.test.mjs asserts edgeTypes.length === 12 (now 15); that file is outside my files, so I did not edit it.
